recipient_user_id.description: Identifier of the owner or technician profile the notification is addressed to

equipment_id.description: Identifier of the equipment the notification concerns

device_id.description: Identifier of the device the notification concerns

source_alert_id.description: Identifier of the alert that triggered the notification

service_request_id.description: Identifier of the service request the notification is about; null when it concerns none

type.description: Kind of event that produced the notification

is_read.description: Whether the user has already read the notification

created_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the notification was raised; never null

read_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the notification was read; null while unread

dismissed_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the user dismissed the notification; null while not dismissed
